integrity: The displayed rational identities follow by exact algebra. The accompanying standard-library program checks them via direct integer-polynomial expansion; no numerical sample is used as an exhaustive proof.
scientific_limitations: Complete prime-period-two classification only for the un-clipped, momentum-free rational scalar kinetic map with positive gain. No higher periods, basins, or nonlinear stability of marginal cycles. Historical priority remains subject to external review.
title: Exact prime-period-two census and sharp secondary stability threshold for a rational kinetic map
